headlines.title: ‘Resign. You’re destroying the country’: Republican voter in key Ohio district slams Trump
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen cruises down I-80 in his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. On day 3 of his road trip, Jon Allen visits Ohio’s 7th and 9th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Open-water lifeguards push to get federally recognized as first responders in U.S.
headlines.description: A new resolution waiting to be voted on by the House of Representatives could help pave the way for open-water lifeguards in the U.S. to be federally recognized as first responders. NBC News' Gabriela Dellan reports.

headlines.title: Trump posts that 'no talks or conversations' are scheduled with Iran
headlines.description: In a social media post, President Trump said that "no talks or conversations" were ongoing or are scheduled with Iran amid the ongoing conflict. NBC News' Matt Bradley reports on the latest developments in the Middle East.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Andy Burnham says he’s not embarrassed about messaging someone impersonating a Trump aide
headlines.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he’s not embarrassed about exchanging messages with someone who impersonated President Donald Trump’s White House chief of staff, Susie Wiles.

headlines.title: San Diego Padres minor-league catching coordinator detained by ICE in Texas
headlines.description: San Diego Padres catching coordinator Oswaldo José Pirela was detained by immigration authorities in El Paso, Texas, and remained in custody, according to family and ICE detainee records.

headlines.title: A Democratic warning sign in Michigan: From the Politics Desk
House ethics panel is investigating Rep. Jimmy Gomez over sexual misconduct allegations
headlines.description: The California Democrat said he’d “made personal mistakes outside my marriage” but said he hadn’t violated the law or House Ethics rules.

headlines.title: Trump threatens to bomb Oman if it ‘gets in the way’ of Strait of Hormuz talks with Iran
headlines.description: Monday marks the end of a 60-day deadline that the U.S. and Iran agreed to in June to end the war and reach an agreement on Iran’s nuclear program.

headlines.title: Supreme Court turns away Trump’s latest bid to block E. Jean Carroll award
headlines.description: The Supreme Court turned away for a second time President Donald Trump’s bid to overturn a jury verdict that awarded $5 million to writer E. Jean Carroll and found Trump liable for sexual abuse and defamation.

headlines.title: Trump orders military to ‘substantially reduce’ joint exercises with South Korea
headlines.description: The president said he has directed the Pentagon to scale down the exercises, citing South Korea’s refusal to join the war in Iran and his “very good” relationship with North Korea’s Kim Jong Un.

headlines.title: Rep. Ro Khanna calls for ‘Data Center Bill of Rights’ and says the industry needs regulation
headlines.description: The California congressman also laid out how he believes he differs from Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, as both progressives are floated as potential presidential candidates.
